title: I Time-Traveled and Confessed to My Teacher Crush
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Seiji Sanada, a nearly 30-year-old office worker, wakes up back in his second year of high school. Regretting that he never confessed to his world history teacher, Haruka Hiiragi, he tells her his feelings, she accepts, and the two begin dating in secret. The series is a flirtatious romantic comedy built on that hidden student-teacher relationship.
life_message: A second chance lets you act on the love you were too timid to declare.
